newsitem.title: USA: Sikorsky wins $745.2 mln Pentagon contract.
newsitem.headline: Sikorsky wins $745.2 mln Pentagon contract.

text.p: United Technologies Corp's Sikorsky Aircraft Corp division was awarded a $745.2 million U.S. defense contract to supply 180 UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters, the U.S. army said on Friday.

The company was awarded $227.8 million as an initial increment of the fixed-price contract for building 36 of the heliciopters in the first year and the remainder over a period of years, with completion by 2002.
The Black Hawk is the U.S. army's primary utility helicopter for moving troops, supplies and military equipment.
